authoritative_documentation.liquidation_stream: Binance COIN-M Liquidation Order Snapshot stream
authoritative_documentation.sampling_rule: For each symbol only the latest one liquidation order within each 1000ms interval is published; intervals without a liquidation publish nothing.
authoritative_documentation.contract_size: COIN-M exchangeInfo contractSize; quantity is a contract count.

problems: The public liquidationSnapshot archive is a censored one-per-symbol-per-second publication, not a complete liquidation ledger. Calling its sums total liquidation flow, total liquidation notional or market share would be false.
The parser previously fell back to original_quantity when both accumulated and last-filled quantity were zero, which could convert an unfilled liquidation order into fictitious executed forced flow.
The source workflow did not bind the pre-outcome COIN-M contract-notional correction into its validated and hashed input inventory.

binding_rules.coverage_interpretation: censored lower-bound observation of forced activity; never complete exchange liquidation volume
binding_rules.feature_language: all count, breadth, side-share, concentration and size features refer only to published executed snapshots
prohibited_inference: absence of liquidations when no snapshot was published
binding_rules.executed_contract_count: accumulated_filled_quantity when positive, otherwise last_filled_quantity when positive; zero otherwise
binding_rules.zero_executed_rows: retain only as source diagnostics; exclude from signal events and model rows
binding_rules.notional_normalization: published executed contract count multiplied by separately hash-recorded exchangeInfo.contractSize; never price times contract count

side_semantics.SELL: published forced sell order, consistent with liquidated long inventory
side_semantics.BUY: published forced buy order, consistent with liquidated short inventory

binding_rules.authority: Only a source artifact generated from the current branch head containing corrections 003 and 004 may open the model stage. Earlier queued or completed artifacts are non-authoritative.
